# `aitbc agent-comm list`

List agents registered in the cross-chain network with optional filters.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-comm list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Filter by chain ID |
| `--status` | choice | — | no | Filter by status |
| `--capabilities` | text | — | no | Filter by capabilities (comma-separated) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-comm list
```
